records.special_conditions: Holders of a 10-year B-1/B-2 visa must enrol in EVUS before boarding, failing to do so provisionally revokes the visa (8 CFR 215.24). EVUS costs USD 30.75.. China is absent from the DHS designated-country list, the alphabetical run passes straight from Chile to Croatia, so ESTA is unavailable. Positive requirement at 8 CFR 212.1: 'A valid unexpired visa...and an unexpired passport, shall be presented by each arriving nonimmigrant ali. A family or group DS-160 is a copying shortcut, not one form for the family. One person completes theirs first, then chooses the family or group option on the confirmation page and the shared answers carry across to the next form. Everyone still files and signs their own.. A parent or legal guardian completes and signs the DS-160 for a child under 16. From 16 the applicant must click sign themselves even if someone else typed the answers, and anyone completing a form for another adult must name themselves as the third party on it.. Do not pay for an invitation letter or an affidavit of support. The State Department states it is not needed and is not used in deciding the case.. There is no asset-free route and no published minimum bank balance. No bank statement appears on the required list, but the consular officer may ask you to show you can pay for the trip, or that someone else will.. Stay per admission is set by CBP, usually up to 6 months. EVUS enrolment (USD 30.75) is required alongside the visa

records.special_conditions: Airlines may require proof of onward travel before boarding. Immigration officers may request proof of funds and accommodation. Entry is at the discretion of the immigration officer. A 30-day extension of stay may be requested at a Thai immigration office

records.special_conditions: Chinese ordinary passport holders are not eligible for Indian e-Visa, a paper sticker visa is required. records.special_conditions: Visa fee waived for children under 6, reduced fee of EUR 45 for children aged 6, 12. records.entry_requirements: Passport: Issued within the last 10 years and valid at least 3 months beyond intended departure from the Schengen Area. Onward travel: Confirmed round-trip flight reservation or onward travel ticket matching the intended itinerary. Accommodation: Hotel bookings covering the whole stay, or a notarised invitation letter from a host in Spain with the host’s passport/residence permit copy. Funds: Bank statements for the last 3, 6 months and proof of income or savings. Spain requires means of subsistence for the stay (amount is tied to the Spanish minimum wage, currently around €108/day with a minimum total). Travel insurance required. Biometrics collected
records.special_conditions: Children aged 5 and under are exempt from the visa fee, children 6, 11 pay a reduced fee of $53. Frequent travellers with a record of compliant Schengen visits may be granted multiple-entry visas valid 1, 2 or 5 years at consular discretion. Family members of EU/EEA/Swiss citizens exercising free movement may qualify for an accelerated or exempt procedure under EU law. Applicants who have provided biometrics for a Schengen visa within the last 59 months may be exempt from re-enrolment. If transiting another Schengen airport and leaving the international transit area, a Schengen short-stay visa is required. Adult fee, children 6-12 pay €40 and under-6 are free Schengen fee EUR 90 since 11 June 2024

records.entry_requirements: Passport: Valid for the full duration of stay in the UK. Onward travel: Not required for a Student visa. Accommodation: Not mandatory. CAS may include accommodation details and proof of arranged accommodation can be submitted as supporting evidence. Funds: Required: proof of funds covering remaining tuition fees plus living costs (currently £1,483 per month for courses in London and £1,136 per month elsewhere, up to 9 months, verify current rates at time of application) held for 28 consecutive days ending no more than 31 days before application. Biometrics collected. Health: Tuberculosis (TB) test certificate
records.special_conditions: Priority Visa and Super Priority Visa services may be available at some VFS Global centres for faster decisions. Applicants under 18 must provide parental/legal guardian consent and proof of relationship. ATAS certificate is required for certain science, engineering, and technology courses. Chinese nationals are not in the UK low-risk group and must provide full financial and qualification evidence. TB test must be taken at an approved clinic only. Application can be submitted up to 6 months before the course start date. UKVI may invite the applicant for a credibility interview. CORRECTION: application fee is £558 from 8 April 2026 (gov.uk/student-visa: 'It costs: £558 to apply for a Student visa from outside the UK'. Home Office fees table 8 April 2026 shows £524 -> £558), superseding stored £490. Stay up to 5 years at degree level, up to 2 years below degree level

records.visa_type_name: Group tourist visa (团队旅游签证)
records.required_documents: Valid ordinary passport, Completed short-term visa application form, Recent passport photo, Travel itinerary / schedule in Japan, Proof of accommodation (hotel bookings or invitation), Financial evidence (bank statements / income certificate), Employment or student certificate if applicable, Residence permit if applying outside China, not applicable here
records.consulate_district: Apply at the Japanese Embassy or Consulate General with jurisdiction over your place of residence. Applying outside your country or region of residence is a stated ground for refusing to accept the application
records.entry_requirements: Passport: Valid for the intended period of stay. Visit Japan Web required (Register before departure for immigration and customs). Onward travel: Return or onward travel itinerary/ticket may be required. Accommodation: Hotel reservations or an invitation letter with the host's residence certificate. Funds: Bank statements for the last 3, 6 months, income certificate, tax records, or other evidence of sufficient funds
records.special_conditions: Single-entry tourist visas for mainland residents are electronic since 19 June 2023: the Visa issuance notice must be shown online at the airport. The consular fee is charged only if the visa is issued, the designated agency charges its own handling fee on top. Individuals cannot apply at the embassy or consulate: every tourist application goes through a designated travel agency, which also books flights and hotels except for the 5-year visa. One earner can carry the family. On the multiple-entry tourist visas the economic test is applied to a lead applicant and family members apply on that standing. Family means a spouse, lineal relatives within two degrees, and siblings living in the same household.. A family member may only apply for the same visa the lead applicant holds or is applying for, not a longer one. Each files a full application of their own and adds a copy of the household register or a notarised kinship certificate, plus a copy of the lead applicant's multiple-entry visa if it has already been issued.. No financial proof at all on a group tour. Booked through a designated travel agency, 5 to about 40 people for up to 15 days, the published list is the passport, the application form with photo and the personal information consent form, because the agency stands as guarantor.. No financial proof for students. An undergraduate or postgraduate at a Chinese university on the Ministry of Education's list, or someone who graduated from one within the last three years, can get a single-entry individual tourist visa without any proof of financial capacity.. No financial proof after two previous visits. Two or more trips to Japan in the past three years on a designated individual tourist visa remove the financial documents for the three-year multiple-entry visa, submit the visa notices from those trips and the passports instead.. A Gold or higher international credit card, UnionPay included, can replace the employment certificate and six months of bank statements on the ordinary single-entry visa. Submit the card and a document showing it is valid.. Fifteen days, fixed for the group scheme. Lodged by a designated travel agency. The agency charges its own service fee on top of the consular fee

Stay of 15, 30 or 90 days set at examination (upper bound shown). Fee 715 CNY from 1 July 2026, applications go through embassy-designated agencies

records.entry_requirements: Passport: 6 months beyond arrival
records.special_conditions: Fee not published in retrievable form on the government portal (fee table is served from an access-restricted API). Non-refundable. records.required_documents: Passport or travel document with Machine Readable Zone (MRZ) with at least 1 month validity (passengers with extended validity in their passports are not allowed to enter), Complete travel itinerary including confirmed return journey tickets, prepaid confirmed booking at a registered facility, and sufficient funds to cover the stay, or a pre-approved sponsorship visa from Maldives Immigration, Traveller Declaration submitted electronically via the IMUGA portal up to 96 hours before arrival (free of charge), Yellow Fever vaccination certificate, if applicable (children under 1 year exempt)
records.entry_requirements: Passport: valid at least 6 months on arrival. Traveller Declaration required (Up to 96 hours (4 days) before arrival, must be filled and submitted electronically via the IMUGA portal (free of charge), and presented at immigration on arrival)
records.special_conditions: Effective 15 April 2025, entry to the Maldives is not granted on Israeli passports (3rd Amendment to Immigration Act 1/2007). The current official Maldives Immigration and MFA pages (immigration.gov.mv/visa/tourist-visa, backup.foreign.gov.mv maldives-visa) confirm the visa is granted on arrival with no pre-approval but do not publish a fee amount for the on-arrival tourist visa, the fee fact therefore remains unset. foreign.gov.mv and mdvmission.gov.mv pages that reportedly state the visa is free are behind an interactive human-verification challenge and could not be read

records.required_documents: Passport valid for at least 6 months, Return flight ticket/booking, Proof of local accommodation, 650 Mozambican meticais entry processing fee (payable in cash or by card at entry)

You must still file the 入境登记卡 (entry registration card) before travel, completed on arrival at the airport and handed with the passport to the border immigration officer, fingerprints are recorded. Passport: 6 months beyond arrival. Onward travel: Confirmed return or onward ticket. Accommodation: Confirmed hotel booking or an invitation letter from a host in Mozambique. Funds: Evidence of sufficient funds for the stay, such as recent bank statement or credit card
records.special_conditions: Airport arrivals must complete an entry registration card and present a passport valid at least 6 months, fingerprints are recorded at immigration. Keep the 650 MZN payment receipt, Mozambican immigration may check it on departure. Diplomatic and official passport holders are visa-exempt up to 30 days under the bilateral agreement. Mozambique grants no visa on arrival to Chinese citizens, travellers not qualifying for the waiver should obtain a visa in advance rather than rely on the discretionary USD 50 border visa

A USD 100 Pristine Paradise Environmental Fee (PPEF) is collected via the air ticket for every visitor (separate from any visa fee). China MFA consular page (cs.mfa.gov.cn) likewise states 30-day entry with USD 50 per extension and no entry fee amount

records.required_documents: valid passport, digital passport scan, digital facial photo, travel insurance valid in Russia, email address, payment card
records.consulate_district: Apply at the Russian consular office covering your place of permanent residence
records.entry_requirements: Passport: Valid at least 6 months beyond intended departure from Russia. Onward travel: Return or onward ticket is not required at application but may be requested at border inspection. Accommodation: Hotel booking or host address is not always required at application but recommended to carry. Funds: Evidence of sufficient funds (bank card, cash, statements) may be checked at the border, not required at application. Travel insurance required
records.special_conditions: Visa-free entry applies until 31 December 2027 inclusive and covers guest or business visits, tourism, participation in scientific, cultural, socio-political, economic or sports events, and transit, for up to 30 days per stay on an ordinary PRC passport. Does not apply to entry for work (including journalistic activity), education, or residence, nor to international road-transport drivers, crew members, freight forwarders, and accompanying interpreters - those purposes still require a visa. Stays over 30 days require a visa, the stay regime is governed by Russian law. Since 23 August 2025 the single electronic visa is valid 120 days from issuance with a permitted stay of up to 30 days from entry

records.entry_requirements: No visa and no travel authorisation. Travel on a valid passport. Passport: Valid for at least 6 months beyond arrival

records.special_conditions: Visa on arrival is available at all official border posts (air, land, or sea) open to foreign nationals that have a Migration Service presence. Single entry, multiple entries may be granted for travellers to Oecussi if declared to the visa processing officer. Extendable once only for a further 30 days: USD 40 fee, in person at Migration Service Headquarters in Dili, up to 15 days processing. Issued at Dili International Airport or Dili Sea Port, extendable once before expiry at immigration in Dili

records.required_documents: valid passport, onward or return ticket, proof of accommodation, proof of sufficient funds

records.special_conditions: Mutual visa exemption between China and Uzbekistan in force since 1 June 2025 (agreement signed in Chengdu on 1 December 2024). Each visa-free entry and stay must not exceed 30 days. Total visa-free stay must not exceed 90 days within any 180-day period. A stay longer than 30 days requires applying for a visa in advance. The visa-free policy does not cover work, study, media, or any other activity that requires special permission

records.required_documents: Valid passport, travel itinerary, payment method, contact information, employment details, prior US travel/refusal history
records.entry_requirements: Passport: Valid for the intended stay. Onward travel: Proof of onward or return travel may be requested by CBP upon arrival. records.special_conditions: ESTA is not a visa. German ordinary passport holders are visa-exempt under the Visa Waiver Program. A valid electronic/machine-readable e-passport is required. ESTA approval does not guarantee admission, final entry decision is made by a CBP officer. If ESTA is denied, the traveler must apply for a B1/B2 visa at a U.S. embassy or consulate. An approved ESTA is mandatory before boarding. ESTA is a travel authorisation, not a visa, apply online at esta.cbp.dhs.gov. Valid two years from authorisation or until the passport expires, whichever comes first

records.required_documents: Machine-readable Spanish e-passport, Travel itinerary, Credit/debit card for fee, Contact and employment information, Previous U.S. travel/refusal details if applicable
records.entry_requirements: Passport: Spanish e-passport valid for the intended stay. Onward travel: Confirmed return or onward ticket required. Accommodation: Not required, but first U.S. address and emergency contact are requested. Funds: Not routinely required for ESTA

records.special_conditions: No transit visa needed if you hold a UK ETA, an EU Settlement Scheme family permit, a Home Office travel document, a Standard Visitor visa or a Marriage Visitor visa. Airside transit without a visa if holding a valid visa for Australia, Canada, New Zealand or the USA (or an expired one used to enter that country within the last 6 months), an Australian/NZ permanent resident visa, a Ca. Holders of Chinese diplomatic or service passports may transit airside without a visa (rule applies to ordinary passports). Electronic visas or permits must be verifiable by the airline to count as an exemption. Visitor in Transit visa holders must leave the UK within 48 hours and must not work or study. Transit Without Visa (landside) only if you arrive and depart by air, hold a confirmed onward flight departing before 23:59 the following day, and hold the correct documents for the destination, a Border Force officer ca. Airside transit without a DATV requires arrival and departure by air, a confirmed same-day onward flight from the same airport and correct documents for the destination. Airside only, no UK border control. Fee is UKVI-set, verify current amount at checkout
